meta.name: ad-management-intake
meta.description: The intake stage of a Meta ad harness. Researches the brand first, states what it assumes, and asks only what it cannot infer and what would change money, claims or legal exposure if guessed wrong — at most four questions a turn, in plain business language. Writes the brand's stable facts (ads/brand.md), the campaign brief, and a log of what was asked vs assumed. Use it when someone wants to run Meta ads and the brand's ad facts are not yet recorded.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把品牌底细问清楚,输出可直接采用的广告投放简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果准备在 Meta 投广告,但品牌卖点与合规事实还没理清
copy.tagline_en: Pin down your brand facts and turn them into a ready Meta ad campaign brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to run Meta ads but your brand's facts and claims aren't captured yet

howto.what: 当你说要在 Meta 投广告,它会先读你的品牌资料,说出自己做的假设,只问最多四个它猜不出来、且猜错会影响钱、宣称或合规的问题;之后写好品牌事实、活动简报、以及「问了什么 vs 假设了什么」的记录。
howto.when: 当你想在 Meta 投广告、而品牌广告事实尚未记录时触发。它会先做品牌研究,已记录的信息不再重复问。

say.text: 我想在 Meta 上投广告,先帮我把品牌信息过一遍
say.note: 它先研究品牌,再列出假设和问题

say.text: 这轮广告总预算 1500 美元,投 3 周
say.note: 预算按总额加时长记入简报

say.text: 广告里不能提客户名字,也不能引用数字
say.note: 作为宣称规则写进 brand.md

howto.what_en: When you want to run Meta ads, it reads the brand first, states its assumptions, and asks at most four questions it cannot infer that would change money, claims or legal exposure. It writes brand facts, the brief and an asked-vs-assumed log.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone wants to run Meta ads and the brand's ad facts are not yet recorded. It researches the brand first and never asks again for facts already recorded.

say_en.text: I want to run Meta ads — walk me through the brand info first
say_en.note: It researches the brand, then lists assumptions and questions
Budget recorded as total plus run time

say_en.text: The ads can't name customers or cite numbers
say_en.note: Saved as claim rules in brand.md
